story: Staunton State Park features dramatic rock outcroppings, several streams and a waterfall in Colorado, USA. Opened on May 18, 2013, the 3,908-acre park was created out of a gift by Frances H. Staunton to be preserved as a natural wilderness-type park.
matters: The park preserves Colorado's beautiful mountain forest and meadow region for public benefit and is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
name: Staunton State Park
